title: Situation report (SITREP)
description: Numbered EOC situation report as printed and handed to a team or posted to the EOC wall: header block, numbered paragraphs (summary, status, actions taken, planned actions, issues), next report time.

examples: Unified Command; Command and General Staff; Airline Station Managers

summary.description: 1. Situation summary: what happened since the last report (3-6 sentences)
examples: At 1100 the IC ordered all FIDS screens dark after IT confirmed unauthorized changes in the AODB.

keyStatus.description: 2. Current status of key systems or functions (label and short value)

value.description: Status in a few words; start with GREEN, YELLOW or RED when it fits
examples: RED: dark by IC order; whiteboard teams deployed

actions.description: 3. Actions taken this period, oldest first

planned.description: 4. Planned actions for the next period

examples: Restore AODB from 0400 backup on an isolated network
AODB vendor engineer has not responded since 0945

nextReport.description: When the next SITREP is due

preparedBy.description: Name and position of the preparer

approvedBy.description: Name and position of the approver

marking.description: Handling marking printed top and bottom (default: EXERCISE EXERCISE EXERCISE)
